funds_data.description: The index includes all REIT securities listed in developed and emerging markets and included as constituents of the S&P Global BMI Shariah Index, a comprehensive global Sharia-compliant index of publicly-traded equity securities. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
